# Generated by tools/build_managers.py.
# The Records: one line of a log, for the country in scope. The caller has set the temporary variables
# ev_kind, ev_fam, ev_kid and one for each part of a line (tools/build_records.py, fill()). The oldest line goes past 500.
# Each kind of line is counted (mod1440_ct), a line of the territory log in that log only.
mod1440_ev_add = {
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_date = global.date }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_day = global.num_days }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_kind = ev_kind }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_fam = ev_fam }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_a = ev_a }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_b = ev_b }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_sa = ev_sa }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_sb = ev_sb }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_c = ev_o }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_sc = ev_so }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_p = ev_p }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_x = ev_x }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_date^num > 500 } }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_date index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_day index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_kind index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_fam index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_a index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_b index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sa index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sb index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_c index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sc index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_p index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_x index = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ev_fam = 2 } } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 47
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 47 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_ct^ev_kid = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = ev_a }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_so = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = ev_o }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
}

mod1440_tr_add = {
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_date = global.date }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_day = global.num_days }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_kind = ev_kind }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_fam = ev_fam }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_a = ev_a }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_b = ev_b }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_sa = ev_sa }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_sb = ev_sb }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_c = ev_o }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_sc = ev_so }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_p = ev_p }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_x = ev_x }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_date^num > 500 } }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_date index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_day index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_kind index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_fam index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_a index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_b index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sa index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sb index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_c index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sc index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_p index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_x index = 0 }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 47
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 47 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_ct^ev_kid = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = ev_a }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_so = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = ev_o }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
}

# The Records: a game saved before a line had an officer has logs without the newer parts. They get a 0 for
# each line that is there, and a capital in the territory log the mark that it stands in the main log too.
mod1440_ev_grow = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_x^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 500
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_c^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_c value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sc value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_p^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_p value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_x^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_x value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 500
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_c^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_c value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sc value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_p^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_p value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_x value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { gr_taken = token:mod1440_ev_capital_taken }
		set_temp_variable = { gr_lost = token:mod1440_ev_capital_lost }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_tr_kind
			value = gr_k
			index = gr_i
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { gr_k = gr_taken } check_variable = { gr_k = gr_lost } } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^gr_i = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Records: which rows of a list are striped: 0, 1, 0, 1 ... for 512 rows.
mod1440_rec_odd = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_odd^num < 512 } }
		set_temp_variable = { odd_v = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 512
			value = odd_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_odd^num < 512 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_odd = odd_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { odd_v = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { odd_v = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { odd_v = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# War Diary: copies the lines the chosen filter wants, newest first, 200 from the chosen place, into the arrays
# the page draws. All goes through both logs together; Territory has a log of its own; every other filter
# reads the main log. Then the figures of the record: sums of the counters, and the days since it began.
mod1440_wd_list = {
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_date
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_kind
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_fam
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_a
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_b
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_sa
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_sb
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_c
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_sc
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_p
	set_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_e = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_t = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_t = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mg_all
			value = mg_i
			set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_e > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_ed = mod1440_ev_day^mg_e }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_td = mod1440_tr_day^mg_t }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mg_td > mg_ed } }
						set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_log = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_m = mg_e }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { wd_seen > mod1440_wd_from } check_variable = { mod1440_wd_fam^num < 200 } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_date = mod1440_ev_date^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_kind = mod1440_ev_kind^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_fam = mod1440_ev_fam^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_a = mod1440_ev_a^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_b = mod1440_ev_b^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sa = mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sb = mod1440_ev_sb^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_c = mod1440_ev_c^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sc = mod1440_ev_sc^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_p = mod1440_ev_p^mg_m }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_log = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_m = mg_t }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_t = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^mg_m = 1 } } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { wd_seen > mod1440_wd_from } check_variable = { mod1440_wd_fam^num < 200 } }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_date = mod1440_tr_date^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_kind = mod1440_tr_kind^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_fam = mod1440_tr_fam^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_a = mod1440_tr_a^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_b = mod1440_tr_b^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sa = mod1440_tr_sa^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sb = mod1440_tr_sb^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_c = mod1440_tr_c^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sc = mod1440_tr_sc^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_p = mod1440_tr_p^mg_m }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 2 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_tr_date^num
			value = wd_n
			set_temp_variable = { wd_m = mod1440_tr_date^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_m = 1 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_m = wd_n }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wd_seen > mod1440_wd_from } check_variable = { mod1440_wd_fam^num < 200 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_date = mod1440_tr_date^wd_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_kind = mod1440_tr_kind^wd_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_fam = mod1440_tr_fam^wd_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_a = mod1440_tr_a^wd_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_b = mod1440_tr_b^wd_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sa = mod1440_tr_sa^wd_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sb = mod1440_tr_sb^wd_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_c = mod1440_tr_c^wd_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sc = mod1440_tr_sc^wd_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_p = mod1440_tr_p^wd_m }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_date^num
			value = wd_n
			set_temp_variable = { wd_m = mod1440_ev_date^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_m = 1 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_m = wd_n }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_fam^wd_m = mod1440_wd_filter } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { wd_seen > mod1440_wd_from } check_variable = { mod1440_wd_fam^num < 200 } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_date = mod1440_ev_date^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_kind = mod1440_ev_kind^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_fam = mod1440_ev_fam^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_a = mod1440_ev_a^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_b = mod1440_ev_b^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sa = mod1440_ev_sa^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sb = mod1440_ev_sb^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_c = mod1440_ev_c^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sc = mod1440_ev_sc^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_p = mod1440_ev_p^wd_m }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_total = wd_seen }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_5 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_2 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_3 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 4 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_4 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 5 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_5 = 2 }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 47
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 47 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^3 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_wars = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^4 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_peace = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^5 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_cap = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^7 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_annex = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^14 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^16 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_taken = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^15 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^17 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_lost = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^36 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_vpt = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^37 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_vpl = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^16 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_capitals = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^21 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^22 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^24 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_govs = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^27 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_comm = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^28 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_prom = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^30 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_dec = ct_sum }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_days = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_wd_days = mod1440_ev_since_day }
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_dirty = 1 }
}

# Characters: what a variable can hold of the officer in scope, in of_me. His number, or for a leader without
# one his place; 0 while that is not known.
mod1440_of_me = {
	set_temp_variable = { of_me = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { of_me = -21474.83648 } }
		set_temp_variable = { of_me = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_me = mod1440_ch_at }
		}
	}
}

# Characters: writes on the character at the place ch_v that he stands there, so that a later day can tell
# whether the place is still his. For the scope of a country: a place nobody stands on leaves the scope
# where it is, and what THIS is there tells that apart.
mod1440_ch_mark = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ch_v > 5368 } }
		var:ch_v = {
			set_temp_variable = { ch_t = THIS }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { ch_t = ch_v } check_variable = { ch_t < 0 } } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = ch_v }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ch_v > global.mod1440_ch_top } }
					set_variable = { global.mod1440_ch_top = ch_v }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Characters: for the country in scope, gives every general and admiral without a number his place, and
# looks whether the places kept so far still lead to their characters. If not, everybody is found again
# (rf_old, rf_new: where each one was and is) and the lists of every country with a record are put right.
mod1440_of_refs = {
	mod1440_ch_adopt = yes
	set_temp_variable = { rf_stale = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { rf_need = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { rf_found = 0 }
	clear_temp_array = rf_old
	clear_temp_array = rf_new
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mod1440_ch_top > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rf_r = global.mod1440_ch_top }
		set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 0 }
		var:rf_r = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_r } }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rf_ok = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rf_stale = 1 }
		}
	}
	every_army_leader = {
		set_temp_variable = { rf_me = THIS }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rf_me = -21474.83648 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_r = mod1440_ch_at }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 0 }
				PREV = {
					var:rf_r = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_r } }
							set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { rf_ok = 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { rf_stale = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_at } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ch_probe = 1 }
					add_to_temp_variable = { rf_need = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	every_navy_leader = {
		set_temp_variable = { rf_me = THIS }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rf_me = -21474.83648 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_r = mod1440_ch_at }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 0 }
				PREV = {
					var:rf_r = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_r } }
							set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { rf_ok = 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { rf_stale = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_at } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ch_probe = 1 }
					add_to_temp_variable = { rf_need = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { rf_stale = 1 } check_variable = { rf_found < rf_need } } }
		set_temp_variable = { rf_c = 5368.70912 }
		set_temp_variable = { rf_top = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 120
			value = rf_block
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { rf_stale = 1 } check_variable = { rf_found < rf_need } } }
				for_loop_effect = {
					start = 0
					end = 1000
					value = rf_i
					var:rf_c = {
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_probe }
							clear_variable = mod1440_ch_probe
							set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_c }
							add_to_temp_variable = { rf_found = 1 }
							set_temp_variable = { rf_top = rf_c }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at > 0 } }
							if = {
								limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_c } } }
								add_to_temp_array = { rf_old = mod1440_ch_at }
								add_to_temp_array = { rf_new = rf_c }
								set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_c }
							}
							set_temp_variable = { rf_top = rf_c }
						}
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { rf_c = 0.00001 }
				}
			}
		}
		every_army_leader = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_probe }
				clear_variable = mod1440_ch_probe
				set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = -1 }
			}
		}
		every_navy_leader = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_probe }
				clear_variable = mod1440_ch_probe
				set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = -1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rf_stale = 1 } }
			set_variable = { global.mod1440_ch_top = rf_top }
			every_country = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 } }
				mod1440_ch_remap = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rf_top > global.mod1440_ch_top } }
				set_variable = { global.mod1440_ch_top = rf_top }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Characters: where the character of the place rm_v stands now, in rm_to: looked up in rf_old and rf_new, and 0
# when nobody at that place says it is his (the character is gone, or was never marked).
mod1440_ch_place = {
	set_temp_variable = { rm_to = rm_v }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rm_v > 5368 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_brk = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = rf_old
			index = rm_k
			value = rm_o
			break = rm_brk
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_o = rm_v } }
				set_temp_variable = { rm_to = rf_new^rm_k }
				set_temp_variable = { rm_brk = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rm_ok = 0 }
		var:rm_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rm_to } }
				set_temp_variable = { rm_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rm_ok = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_to = 0 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { rm_lost = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Characters: puts right every place the country in scope keeps, after the game's list of characters has
# changed: the people on the lines of both logs, the list of officers, the chosen officer, the offices.
mod1440_ch_remap = {
	set_temp_variable = { rm_lost = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_ev_a^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_ev_a^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_a^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_ev_c^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_ev_c^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_c^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_tr_a^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_tr_a^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_tr_a^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_tr_c^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_tr_c^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_tr_c^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_of_known^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_of_known^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_known^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	clear_temp_array = rm_keep
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_known
		value = rm_v
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rm_v = 0 } } }
			add_to_temp_array = { rm_keep = rm_v }
		}
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_of_known
	for_each_loop = {
		array = rm_keep
		value = rm_v
		add_to_array = { mod1440_of_known = rm_v }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_of_sel }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_sel = rm_to }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_sel = 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { rm_lost = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_leader }
	mod1440_ch_place = yes
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader = rm_to }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_of_0 }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0 = rm_to }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_of_1 }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1 = rm_to }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_of_2 }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2 = rm_to }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_of_3 }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3 = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_gv_adv^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_adv^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_adv^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_gv_hc^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_hc^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_hc^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rm_lost > 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 0 }
	}
}

# Characters: once for a country, marks everybody whose place its lists hold already (a game saved by an
# earlier build of the mod).
mod1440_ch_adopt = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_adopted = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ch_adopted = 1 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_a^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_ev_a^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_c^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_ev_c^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_tr_a^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_tr_a^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_tr_c^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_tr_c^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_of_known^num
			value = rm_i
			set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_of_known^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_mark = yes
		}
		mod1440_gv_marks = yes
	}
}

# Characters: marks the holders of the offices the Government page keeps.
mod1440_gv_marks = {
	set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_leader }
	mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_of_0 }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_of_1 }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_of_2 }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_of_3 }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_gv_adv
		value = ch_v
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_gv_hc
		value = ch_v
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
}

# Officers: marks every officer who serves today with the day, and adds an officer the record does not know
# yet to its list. A retired officer keeps his place in that list (X34).
mod1440_of_seen = {
	mod1440_of_refs = yes
	set_temp_variable = { of_had = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_listed = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { of_had = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { of_new = 0 }
	every_army_leader = {
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day = global.num_days }
		mod1440_of_me = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_known = of_me }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_had = 1 } NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_of_since_day } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_since = global.date }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_since_day = global.num_days }
				add_to_temp_variable = { of_new = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { of_new < 9 } }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_commissioned }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 27 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_a = of_me }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
					PREV = {
						mod1440_ev_add = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 20710 } } }
			mod1440_p_officer = yes
		}
	}
	every_navy_leader = {
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day = global.num_days }
		mod1440_of_me = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_known = of_me }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_had = 1 } NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_of_since_day } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_since = global.date }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_since_day = global.num_days }
				add_to_temp_variable = { of_new = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { of_new < 9 } }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_commissioned }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 27 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_a = of_me }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
					PREV = {
						mod1440_ev_add = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 20710 } } }
			mod1440_p_officer = yes
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_listed = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { of_new > 8 } }
		set_temp_variable = { of_more = of_new }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { of_more = 8 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_commissioned_more }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 38 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_ct^27 = of_more }
	}
}

# Officers: makes the list of the page again: who the filter wants, in the order of the chosen column,
# every second row marked for its stripe.
mod1440_of_list = {
	mod1440_of_seen = yes
	clear_array = mod1440_of_rows
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_known
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 20710 } } }
			mod1440_p_officer = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 5 } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 5 } } check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 1 } is_navy_leader = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 2 } NOT = { is_navy_leader = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 3 } check_variable = { num_units < 1 } check_variable = { num_ships < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 4 } check_variable = { mod1440_of_dec^num < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_keep = 1 } }
			mod1440_of_me = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
				add_to_array = { ROOT.mod1440_of_rows = of_me }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_sort_by > 0 } }
		clear_array = mod1440_of_keys
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mod1440_of_rows
			set_temp_variable = { of_key = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = skill_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = attack_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = defense_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = planning_level }
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { of_key = maneuvering_level }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = logistics_level }
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { of_key = coordination_level }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = num_traits }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 7 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = num_units }
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { of_key = num_ships }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 8 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = mod1440_of_won }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = mod1440_of_lost }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 10 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = mod1440_of_dec^num }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_up = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { of_key = -1 }
			}
			add_to_array = { ROOT.mod1440_of_keys = of_key }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_of_sorted
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_of_rows^num
			value = of_step
			find_highest_in_array = {
				array = mod1440_of_keys
				value = of_high
				index = of_at
			}
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_sorted = mod1440_of_rows^of_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_keys^of_at = -2000000 }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_of_rows
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_of_sorted
			value = of_copy
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_rows = of_copy }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { of_par = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_rows
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_odd = of_par }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_par = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_par = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { of_par = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_5 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_2 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_3 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 4 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_4 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 5 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_5 = 2 }
	}
	mod1440_md_list = yes
	mod1440_of_card = yes
}

# Officers: copies the chosen officer's values, record, decorations and diary lines to the country, where
# his file reads them. His own values are read in his scope (X33).
mod1440_of_card = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } }
		mod1440_ev_grow = yes
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_key
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_date
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_set
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_frame
		var:mod1440_of_sel = {
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_skill = skill_level }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_rank = 2 }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_cmd = num_units }
			if = {
				limit = { is_field_marshal = yes }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_rank = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_rank = 3 }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_cmd = num_ships }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_won = mod1440_of_won }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_lost = mod1440_of_lost }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_states = mod1440_of_states }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_vps = mod1440_of_vps }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_vpl = mod1440_of_vpl }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 20710 } } }
				mod1440_p_officer = yes
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_p = mod1440_p }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_since = mod1440_of_since }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_since = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_since_day > 0 } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_since = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_prom = mod1440_of_prom }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_prom = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_prom_day > 0 } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_prom = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_lvl = mod1440_of_lvl }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_lvl = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_lvl_day > 0 } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_lvl = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_former = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_former = 1 }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_key
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_key = of_v }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_date
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_date = of_v }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_set
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_set = of_v }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_frame
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_frame = of_v }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_c_dec_n = mod1440_of_c_dec_key^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 7
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_c_dec_key^num < 7 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_key = token:mod1440_blank }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_date = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_set = -1 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_frame = 1 }
			}
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_md_id
			value = md_v
			index = md_i
			set_temp_variable = { md_h = 0 }
			var:mod1440_of_sel = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec value = md_v } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_h = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_md_has^md_i = md_h }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_date
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_kind
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_a
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_sa
		set_temp_variable = { mg_e = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_t = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_t = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mg_all
			value = mg_i
			set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_e > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_ed = mod1440_ev_day^mg_e }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_td = mod1440_tr_day^mg_t }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mg_td > mg_ed } }
						set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_log = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_m = mg_e }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_date^num < 7 } OR = { AND = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_a^mg_m = mod1440_of_sel } } AND = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_c^mg_m = mod1440_of_sel } } } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_date = mod1440_ev_date^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_kind = mod1440_ev_kind^mg_m }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m > 1 } }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = mod1440_ev_a^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = 0 }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = 0 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_log = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_m = mg_t }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_t = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^mg_m = 1 } } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_date^num < 7 } OR = { AND = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_tr_a^mg_m = mod1440_of_sel } } AND = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_tr_c^mg_m = mod1440_of_sel } } } }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_date = mod1440_tr_date^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_kind = mod1440_tr_kind^mg_m }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^mg_m > 1 } }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = mod1440_tr_a^mg_m }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = mod1440_tr_sa^mg_m }
						}
						else = {
							add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = 0 }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = 0 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_n = mod1440_of_ln_date^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 7
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_date^num < 7 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_date = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_kind = token:mod1440_blank }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_dirty = 1 }
}

# Officers: the medals the country in scope has, by the game's own conditions (tools/unit_medals_table.py),
# 12 at most. They fill the Award buttons of the file.
mod1440_md_list = {
	clear_array = mod1440_md_id
	clear_array = mod1440_md_key
	clear_array = mod1440_md_set
	clear_array = mod1440_md_frame
	clear_array = mod1440_md_has
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_norwegian_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 1 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:krigskorset }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 17 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_norwegian_medals_trigger = yes OR = { has_government = democratic has_government = neutrality } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 2 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:haakon_viis_frihetskors }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 17 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_norwegian_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 3 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:krigsmedaljen }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 17 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_norwegian_medals_trigger = yes OR = { has_government = democratic has_government = neutrality } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 4 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:haakon_viis_frihetsmedalje }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 17 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_norwegian_medals_trigger = yes has_government = communism }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 5 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:folketskors }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 2 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_norwegian_medals_trigger = yes has_government = fascism }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 6 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:norgeskors }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 9 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_norwegian_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 7 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:deltagermedaljen }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 17 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_norwegian_medals_trigger = yes OR = { has_government = democratic has_government = neutrality } date > 1942.8.3 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 8 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:haakon_viis_70arsmedalje }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 17 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_norwegian_medals_trigger = yes OR = { has_government = democratic has_government = neutrality } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 9 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:st_olavsmedaljen }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 17 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_finnish_medals_trigger = yes NOT = { has_government = communism } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 10 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:mannerheim_cross }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 10 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_finnish_medals_trigger = yes has_government = communism }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 11 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:order_of_the_red_star_finland }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 10 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_finnish_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 12 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:cross_of_liberty }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 10 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_finnish_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 13 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:order_of_the_white_rose }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 10 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_finnish_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 14 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:order_of_the_lion }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 10 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } tag = SWE has_country_flag = SWE_hero_of_narvik }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 15 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:norwegian_defense_cross_of_honor }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 4 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_danish_medals_trigger = yes NOT = { has_government = communism } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 16 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:order_of_the_dannebrog }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 6 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_danish_medals_trigger = yes has_government = communism }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 17 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:order_of_the_civil_union }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 6 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_german_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 18 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:iron_cross_second_class }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 12 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_german_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 19 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:knights_cross }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 12 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_german_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 20 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:knights_cross_oak_leaves }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 12 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } should_have_german_medals_trigger = yes }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 21 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:knights_cross_swords_and_diamonds }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 12 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 4 }

# Officers: gives the chosen officer the medal of slot md_k, once. A record of the mod: arrays on the
# officer. The War Diary gets a line.
mod1440_md_award = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } check_variable = { md_k < mod1440_md_count } }
		set_temp_variable = { md_id = mod1440_md_id^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_key = mod1440_md_key^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_set = mod1440_md_set^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_frame = mod1440_md_frame^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_done = 0 }
		var:mod1440_of_sel = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec value = md_id } } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec = md_id }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_key = md_key }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_date = global.date }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_set = md_set }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_frame = md_frame }
				set_temp_variable = { md_done = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { md_done = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_decorated }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 30 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = mod1440_of_sel }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		mod1440_of_card = yes
	}
}
mod1440_md_takeback = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } }
		var:mod1440_of_sel = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_dec^num > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_n = mod1440_of_dec^num }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { md_n = 1 }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_key index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_date index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_set index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_frame index = md_n }
			}
		}
		mod1440_of_card = yes
	}
}

# Government: compares who holds each office with yesterday's copy. A new name gets today's date and a line
# in the War Diary, a name that is gone a line. The first run only takes the copy. Then the laws in force,
# the length of the parties' bars, the leader's portrait and the figures of the record.
mod1440_gv_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader = country_leader } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader = country_leader }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_since = global.date }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_old = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_old = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_leader }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 24 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = country_leader }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { p_face = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver = 20710 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_of = country_leader } } } }
		set_temp_variable = { p_ld = country_leader }
		var:p_ld = {
			mod1440_p_leader = yes
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p = p_tok }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver = 20710 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_of = country_leader }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { p_face = mod1440_ld_p }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_p = p_face }
	if = {
		limit = { any_character = { is_army_chief = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0 = army_chief } } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0 = army_chief }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_since = global.date }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_old = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_old = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_appointed }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 25 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = army_chief }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_dismissed }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 26 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = mod1440_gv_of_0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_character = { is_navy_chief = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1 = navy_chief } } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1 = navy_chief }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_since = global.date }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_old = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_old = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_appointed }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 25 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = navy_chief }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 0 }

				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_dismissed }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 26 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = mod1440_gv_of_1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_character = { is_air_chief = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2 = air_chief } } } }

			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 }

			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_old = 1 }

				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 25 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = air_chief }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
