	mod1440_gv_marks = yes
}

# Wars: a row for the enemy in wr_c, from today (wr_old = 1: the war ran when the record began).
mod1440_wr_open = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_wr_enemy value = wr_c } } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_enemy = wr_c }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_since = global.date }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_day0 = global.num_days }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_cas0 = casualties }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_taken = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_lost = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_days = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_cas = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_capd = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_old = wr_old }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_surr = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_vpt = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_vpl = 0 }
	}
}
mod1440_wr_grow = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpt^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 200
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpt^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_vpt = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpl^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_vpl = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_vpt^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 200
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_vpt^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_vpt = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_vpl^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_vpl = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Wars: the war with wr_c is over: its row moves to the finished wars with the end date, its length, what it
# cost and how it ended. The file that was open stays on the same war.
mod1440_wr_close = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_j = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_v = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_j = wr_i }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_j > -1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_peace }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_j = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_capitulated }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = subjects value = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_subject }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:wr_c = { exists = no } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_gone }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_j = 2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_annexed }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_d = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_d = mod1440_wr_day0^wr_j }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_k = casualties }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_k = mod1440_wr_cas0^wr_j }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_enemy value = wr_c index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_since value = mod1440_wr_since^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_until value = global.date index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_days value = wr_d index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_cas value = wr_k index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_taken value = mod1440_wr_taken^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lost value = mod1440_wr_lost^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_outcome value = wr_out index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_old value = mod1440_wr_old^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpt value = mod1440_wr_vpt^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpl value = mod1440_wr_vpl^wr_j index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_enemy index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_since index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_day0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_cas0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_taken index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lost index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_days index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_cas index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_capd index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_old index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_surr index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_vpt index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_vpl index = wr_j }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_kind = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_i = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_kind = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_i = wr_j } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_kind = 2 }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_i = 0 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_i > wr_j } }
				subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_i = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_enemy^num > 200 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_last = mod1440_wo_enemy^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_last = 1 }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_enemy index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_since index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_until index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_days index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_cas index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_taken index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lost index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_outcome index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_old index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpt index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpl index = wr_last }
		}
	}
}

# Wars: one more state taken from (wr_f = 1) or lost to (wr_f = 2) the enemy in wr_c, or one more victory
# point taken (3) or lost (4).
mod1440_wr_count = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_j = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_v = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_j = wr_i }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_j > -1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_taken^wr_j = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_lost^wr_j = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 3 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpt^wr_j = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 4 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpl^wr_j = 1 }
		}
	}
}
mod1440_wr_annexed = {
	set_temp_variable = { wr_j = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_v = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_j = wr_i }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_j > -1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_j = 2 }
	}
}

# Wars: the numbers of today's rows, each enemy's surrender progress for its bar, and a line in the War
# Diary when an enemy or the country itself has capitulated. Then the file of the chosen war.
mod1440_wr_daily = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		set_temp_variable = { wr_d = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_d = mod1440_wr_day0^wr_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_days^wr_i = wr_d }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_k = casualties }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_k = mod1440_wr_cas0^wr_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_cas^wr_i = wr_k }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_s = 0 }
		var:wr_v = {
			set_temp_variable = { wr_s = surrender_progress }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { wr_s = 100 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_surr^wr_i = wr_s }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_i = 0 } var:wr_v = { has_capitulated = yes } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_i = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capitulated }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = wr_v }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_capitulated = yes NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_capd = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_capd = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_we_capitulated }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_capitulated = no }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_capd = 0 }
	}
}

# Wars: what the page needs when it is on show. With nothing chosen yet, the file opens on the first war
# there is.
mod1440_wr_show = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_kind < 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_enemy^num > 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_kind = 1 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_i = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_enemy^num > 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_kind = 2 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_i = 0 }
		}
	}
	mod1440_wr_card = yes
}

# Wars: copies the chosen war to the variables its file reads, looks up the two portraits and gathers the
# lines the War Diary has about this enemy, newest first.
mod1440_wr_card = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_has = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_enemy = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_enemy = THIS }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_kind = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_i < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_has = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_enemy = mod1440_wr_enemy^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_since = mod1440_wr_since^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_old = mod1440_wr_old^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_days = mod1440_wr_days^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_cas = mod1440_wr_cas^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_taken = mod1440_wr_taken^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_lost = mod1440_wr_lost^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_vpt = mod1440_wr_vpt^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_vpl = mod1440_wr_vpl^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_surr = mod1440_wr_surr^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_capd = mod1440_wr_capd^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_kind = 2 } check_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_i < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_has = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_enemy = mod1440_wo_enemy^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_since = mod1440_wo_since^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_old = mod1440_wo_old^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_days = mod1440_wo_days^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_cas = mod1440_wo_cas^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_taken = mod1440_wo_taken^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_lost = mod1440_wo_lost^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_vpt = mod1440_wo_vpt^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_vpl = mod1440_wo_vpl^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_until = mod1440_wo_until^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_outcome = mod1440_wo_outcome^mod1440_wr_sel_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_surr = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_capd = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_has = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ours = surrender_progress }
		multiply_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ours = 100 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_exists = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:mod1440_wr_c_enemy = { exists = yes } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_exists = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { p_face = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
		var:mod1440_wr_c_enemy = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver = 20710 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_of = country_leader } } } }
					set_temp_variable = { p_ld = country_leader }
					var:p_ld = {
						mod1440_p_leader = yes
					}
					set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p = p_tok }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver = 20710 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_of = country_leader }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { p_face = mod1440_ld_p }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_p = p_face }
		clear_array = mod1440_wr_ln_date
		clear_array = mod1440_wr_ln_kind
		clear_array = mod1440_wr_ln_a
		clear_array = mod1440_wr_ln_sa
		set_temp_variable = { mg_e = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_t = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_t = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mg_all
			value = mg_i
			set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_e > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_ed = mod1440_ev_day^mg_e }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_td = mod1440_tr_day^mg_t }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mg_td > mg_ed } }
						set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_log = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_m = mg_e }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_ln_date^num < 20 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sb^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_b^mg_m = mod1440_wr_c_enemy } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_date = mod1440_ev_date^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_kind = mod1440_ev_kind^mg_m }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m > 1 } }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_a = mod1440_ev_a^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_sa = mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_a = 0 }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_sa = 0 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_log = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_m = mg_t }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_t = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^mg_m = 1 } } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_ln_date^num < 20 } check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sb^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_tr_b^mg_m = mod1440_wr_c_enemy } }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_date = mod1440_tr_date^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_kind = mod1440_tr_kind^mg_m }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^mg_m > 1 } }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_a = mod1440_tr_a^mg_m }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_sa = mod1440_tr_sa^mg_m }
						}
						else = {
							add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_a = 0 }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_sa = 0 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ln_n = mod1440_wr_ln_date^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 20
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_ln_date^num < 20 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_date = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_kind = token:mod1440_blank }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_a = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_sa = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Records: what the window shows. Sets the buttons' frames and makes the list of the open page.
mod1440_rec_show = {
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_c_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_c_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	mod1440_rec_odd = yes
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_3 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_2 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_3 = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_hn_frame = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_frame = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 0 } }
		mod1440_wd_list = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 1 } }
		mod1440_of_list = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 2 } }
		mod1440_gv_daily = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 3 } }
		mod1440_gv_daily = yes
		mod1440_wr_daily = yes
		mod1440_wr_show = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_dirty = 1 }
}

# The Records: the first run for the country in scope. Takes the copies the daily comparison needs, opens a
# row for each war that already runs and writes the first line.
mod1440_ev_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.mod1440_sr_named = 1 } } }
		every_state = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_sr_from } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_sr_from = PREV }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.mod1440_sr_named = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_since = global.date }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_since_day = global.num_days }
		mod1440_rec_odd = yes
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_begins }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
		for_each_loop = {
			array = enemies
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_c = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 1 }
			mod1440_wr_open = yes
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = subjects
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_subjects = ev_c }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_fac = ev_in }
		clear_array = mod1440_gv_fac
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_gv_fac = ev_c }
		}
		mod1440_gv_daily = yes
		mod1440_of_seen = yes
	}
}

# The Records: once a day for a player's country. The victory points first, while yesterday's enemies are
# still known. Then what no hook tells, found by comparing with yesterday: the end of a war, a new or lost
# subject, the faction, the offices. Then the numbers of the wars.
mod1440_rec_daily = {
	mod1440_ev_init = yes
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_war = yes }
		mod1440_vp_scan = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { mod1440_vp_ver = 0 }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = enemies
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_war_with }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			set_temp_variable = { wr_c = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 0 }
			mod1440_wr_open = yes
		}
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_ev_enemies
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = enemies value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_peace }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			set_temp_variable = { wr_c = ev_c }
			mod1440_wr_close = yes
		}
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_ev_enemies
	for_each_loop = {
		array = enemies
		value = ev_c
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = ev_c }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = subjects
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_subjects value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_subject_new }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 8 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_ev_subjects
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = subjects value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_subject_gone }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 9 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_ev_subjects
	for_each_loop = {
		array = subjects
		value = ev_c
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_subjects = ev_c }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_fac = ev_in } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_in = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_faction_in }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = faction_leader }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_faction_out }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 11 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_fac = ev_in }
		clear_array = mod1440_gv_fac
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_gv_fac = ev_c }
		}
	}
	else = {
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_gv_fac value = ev_c } } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_member_in }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 12 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_gv_fac
			value = ev_c
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = faction_members value = ev_c } } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_member_out }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 13 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_gv_fac
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_gv_fac = ev_c }
		}
	}
	mod1440_wr_daily = yes
	mod1440_gv_daily = yes
	mod1440_of_seen = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 } }
		mod1440_rec_show = yes
	}
}

# The Records: a war has begun between the country in scope and wr_c (a hook says who attacked).
mod1440_ev_war_on = {
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_war_on }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_b = wr_c }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
	mod1440_ev_add = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 0 }
	mod1440_wr_open = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = wr_c } } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = wr_c }
	}
}
mod1440_ev_war_by = {

	set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 2 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_b = wr_c }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }

	mod1440_wr_open = yes

		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = wr_c } } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = wr_c }
	}
}

# The Records: the general of the country in scope with the most divisions in the state tr_s: of_who, and
# of_best how many divisions that is (0: nobody stands there).
mod1440_of_best = {
	set_temp_variable = { of_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { of_who = 0 }
	every_army_leader = {
		set_temp_variable = { of_n = num_units_in_state@var:tr_s }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_n > of_best } }
			mod1440_of_me = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_best = of_n }
				set_temp_variable = { of_who = of_me }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Records: the country in scope has taken the state tr_s from tr_c (tr_cap = 1: a capital). A line with
# the general on the spot, the count of the war and his own, what the state card shows, and the honour.
mod1440_tr_taken = {
	mod1440_of_best = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capital_taken }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 16 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 1 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_state_taken }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 14 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { wr_c = tr_c }
	set_temp_variable = { wr_f = 1 }
	mod1440_wr_count = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
		var:of_who = {
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_of_states = 1 }
		}
	}
	var:tr_s = {
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_day = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_from = tr_c }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto = 1 } has_dlc = "By Blood Alone" }
		set_temp_variable = { hn_n = 0 }
		var:tr_s = {
			every_state_division = {
				limit = { OWNER = { tag = ROOT } }
				add_history_entry = {
					key = mod1440_hn_capture
					subject = "Capital"
					allow = no
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { hn_n = 1 }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_count = hn_n }
	}
}
mod1440_tr_lost = {
	mod1440_of_best = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capital_lost }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 17 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 1 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_state_lost }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { wr_c = tr_c }
	set_temp_variable = { wr_f = 2 }
	mod1440_wr_count = yes
}
